supersede_reason: v1 produced zero role-comparable pairs in both countries. Graph extraction added non-actors (MiroFish, PyroSync, 'internal simulated discussion board', 'active cell-day review scenario') and duplicated roles, so no independent/coordinated pair shared the intended actor set. v1 runs are retained as a recorded negative result and are not rescored.

role_lock.rule: Exactly one prepared profile per intended actor, verified against the upstream profile listing immediately before the simulation starts.
role_lock.enforced_in: pyrosync/mirofish.py role_lock_status, checked in the 'ready' phase
role_lock.on_violation: The run is marked failed before /api/simulation/start. No simulation or report is paid for, and the run is excluded from pairing rather than scored.
role_lock.unverifiable_listing: A persona count without names does not satisfy the lock; the run stops.

fixed_questions: What does missing coverage prevent us concluding?

held_constant_across_policies: declared reviewer count and reviews per person per day
upstream revision and runtime patch hash
matching.pair_definition: One independent run and one coordinated run with the same country and replicate label, both completed, both satisfying the role lock.

evaluation.automated_screening: does not replace blinded domain review
evaluation.reviewer_independence: Reviewers must not be the run operator and must score independently before discussing any report.

outcome_scope.measured: communication quality of generated narratives against a deterministic evidence brief
outcome_scope.deterministic_invariant: Queue metrics depend only on workload and declared capacity and must be identical between policies for the same country/month; generated prose cannot modify them.

replicate_label_note: The current upstream API exposes no controlled random seed. Replicate labels distinguish repeated runs under identical settings; they do not reproduce a run.
spending: bounded scenarios/rounds/personas; provider monetary cost reported only if available, never inferred from round count. The role lock exists partly so that incomparable runs are not paid for.
efficacy_claim: abstain until the minimum eligible pairs exist and independent blinded scores are recorded
dependencies: Configured LLM and Zep credentials for the pinned MiroFish backend (tracked separately).
